auth.tagline: Meeting protocols, and the recordings behind them.
auth.notLinkedHeading: Your account is not linked yet.
auth.notLinkedBody: Run {command} in Discord, then sign in again. The console finds your recordings by your Discord account, and the link is what connects the two.

error.notFoundDetail: The address is wrong, or the page has moved.
error.unreachableDetail: The console reached the browser but could not reach the service behind it. This is not a sign-in problem — signing in again will not help. It usually means the service is restarting, and usually resolves within a minute.
error.genericDetail: The console could not load this page. Trying again is worth one attempt; if it keeps happening, the service is likely unwell rather than the page.

dashboard.intro: Everything Sturnus has recorded of you, across every meeting.
dashboard.failedHeading: Your figures could not be loaded.
dashboard.failedDetail: {reason} Nothing is lost — this page only reads, and the recordings behind it are unaffected.
dashboard.emptyHeading: Sturnus has not recorded you yet.
dashboard.emptyNote: Join a voice channel Sturnus is recording. Once the meeting ends it transcribes what was said, writes the protocol into Outline, and this page fills in: how long you spoke, who you spoke with, and which meetings produced a protocol you were part of.
dashboard.speechNothingMeasured: Your one track was never measured; it predates the measurement. | None of your {count} tracks were measured; they predate the measurement.
dashboard.speechSkipped: One track recorded before Sturnus measured speech is not counted. | {count} tracks recorded before Sturnus measured speech are not counted.
dashboard.protocolsNote: of one session attended | of {count} sessions attended
dashboard.failureSession: Your session is no longer valid.
dashboard.failureNoDashboard: This API has no dashboard yet; it is older than this console.
dashboard.failureUnreachable: The API could not be reached.
dashboard.failureStatus: The API answered {code} and could not produce your figures.

recordings.intro: These are the meetings you were in. Sturnus records one track per speaker who consented before the recording began, and nobody else — anyone in the channel who did not consent is listed but has no audio here. This is the material each protocol was transcribed from, so when a protocol reads wrong, this is where the answer is.
recordings.failedHeading: Your sessions could not be loaded.
recordings.failedDetail: Nothing was lost; the recordings are on the server either way.
recordings.pastEndHeading: There is nothing on this page.
recordings.pastEndDetail: There is one recording in all, and this page is past the end of it. | There are {count} recordings in all, and this page is past the end of them.
recordings.noMatchHeading: Nothing matched what you asked for.
recordings.noMatchDetail: Your recordings are all still there — this search just does not describe any of them.
recordings.emptyList: No recordings yet. A session appears here once Sturnus has been in a voice channel with you.
recordings.searchPlaceholder: channel, who was there, or one of your tags
recordings.searchScopeNote: Searches the channel name, who was in the meeting, and your own tags. It does not search what was said: a transcript is everybody else's words, and they consented to a protocol being written from them, not to being searchable.
recordings.nobodyConsented: Nobody in this session consented to being recorded, so it has no tracks.
recordings.alsoInChannel: Also in the channel, not recorded:
recordings.nothingToPlay: There is nothing to play: no track was written for this session.
recordings.missingDetail: Either it never existed, or it belongs to a session you were not in. Sturnus does not say which — the existence of a meeting you were not part of is not something a link should be able to confirm.
recordings.oneFailedHeading: This recording could not be loaded.
recordings.oneFailedDetail: Nothing was lost; the recording is on the server either way.
recordings.noProtocolWritten: No protocol was written for this session.
recordings.alsoInChannelUnrecorded: Also in the channel, without a recording: {people}
recordings.wholeMeetingNote: Every speaker on one transport, which is the only way a conversation makes sense. Solo and mute turn tracks down rather than stopping them, so unmuting lands you where everybody else already is.
recordings.eachTrackNote: For when the question is what one person said rather than what was discussed. Each player is independent of the transport above and of every other track here.
recordings.noAudio: Nobody in this session had consented before it began, so there is no audio.
recordings.spectrogramShow: Show spectrogram — see where the speech is without listening
recordings.spectrogramFailed: This track could not be drawn. The audio above is unaffected.
recordings.frequencyNote: Frequency runs bottom to top, 0 to {top} kHz. Speech is the banded region low down; a flat picture is a track with nothing on it.
recordings.tagsNote: Labels you put on this recording so you can find it again. Only you can see them — everybody else who was in this meeting has their own, and neither of you sees the other's.
recordings.noTags: This recording has no tags yet.
recordings.addTagLabel: Add a tag to this recording
recordings.tagHint: Separate several with commas. {left} of {max} left on this recording.
recordings.tagTooLong: A tag can be at most {count} characters.
recordings.tagTooMany: A recording can carry at most {count} tags.
recordings.tagAlreadyHeld: That tag is already on this recording.
recordings.tagSaveUnreachable: Your tags could not be saved: the console could not reach the server.
recordings.tagSaveGone: This recording is no longer yours to label.
recordings.tagSaveFailed: Your tags could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

calendar.intro: Every day Sturnus recorded a meeting, and what happened on it.
calendar.yearFailedHeading: The calendar for {year} could not be loaded.
calendar.yearFailedDetail: The API answered with an error. Nothing has been lost — this view only reads.
calendar.emptyYearDetail: A cell appears here for every day Sturnus joined a Discord voice channel and recorded a meeting. Invite the bot to a channel and start a session, or {then}
calendar.emptyYearOtherYears: use the arrows above to look at another year.
calendar.emptyYearWait: wait for the first meeting to be recorded.
calendar.dayFailed: The sessions for {date} could not be loaded.
calendar.gridCaption: Recording activity for {year}, one cell per UTC day, laid out as weeks. Use the arrow keys to move between days and Enter to open one.
calendar.daySummary: One session, {duration} in total. | {count} sessions, {duration} in total.
calendar.dayUnknownLengths: One of them has no recorded length. | {count} of them have no recorded length.
calendar.zoneNote: The API groups days in UTC; the clock below is {zone}, so this day runs from {start} to {end} where you are.

reporting.intro: How one Discord server uses Sturnus: how many meetings it has recorded, how long they ran, how many of them were written up, and how that has changed month by month.
reporting.noGuildsHeading: There is nothing here for you yet
reporting.noGuildsBody: This section reports how one Discord server uses Sturnus, and it is open to the administrators of a server where Sturnus is running. You administer none of them right now.
reporting.noGuildsRole: Administrators are the members holding the Discord role that server names in its {setting} setting. Somebody who already has it can grant you that role — Sturnus mirrors the membership from Discord, so the change reaches this console on its own.
reporting.shapeHeading: What a meeting here looks like
reporting.shapeNote: Averages over the meetings that have finished. A figure shown as an em dash is missing rather than zero, and says underneath why there is none.
reporting.tableCaption: Meetings recorded in this server by month, oldest first
reporting.caveatsHeading: Before you quote any of this
reporting.scopeNote: Every figure here is about the server as a whole and never about the people in it. Sturnus sends this page no names and no ids, and there is no per-person breakdown behind it — how long one named person sat in meetings, or spoke in them, is a measure of that person rather than of this server, and that is not something a console should hand out. Counts of people are counts, and stop there.
reporting.emptyHeading: Sturnus has not recorded anything in this server yet
reporting.emptyNote: There are no meetings here to report on, so this page shows no figures rather than a grid of zeros — a zero would be a measurement, and nothing has been measured. Once a meeting happens in a channel Sturnus watches and the people in it have consented, this page fills in: how many meetings, how long they ran, how many of them were written up, and how that changed month by month.
reporting.documentedNothing: Nothing has been recorded in this server yet, so there is nothing to write up.
reporting.documentedAll: The one meeting recorded in this server reached a protocol. | Every one of the {count} meetings recorded in this server reached a protocol.
reporting.documentedPartial: {documented} of the {sessions} meetings recorded in this server reached a protocol — {share} %. The other one was recorded and never written up. | {documented} of the {sessions} meetings recorded in this server reached a protocol — {share} %. The other {count} were recorded and never written up.
reporting.documentedOpen: One meeting is still recording and cannot have been written up yet; it is counted in the total all the same. | {count} meetings are still recording and cannot have been written up yet; they are counted in the total all the same.
reporting.recordedScope: Adds up the length of every meeting in this server that has ended.
reporting.recordedOpenExcluded: The one still recording is not in it — a meeting has no length until it stops. | The {count} still recording are not in it — a meeting has no length until it stops.
reporting.recordedAllEnded: Adds up the length of every meeting this server has recorded, all of which have ended.
reporting.openNone: Nothing is being recorded in this server right now — every meeting it has recorded has ended and has a length.
reporting.openSome: One meeting in this server has no end time yet. | {count} meetings in this server have no end time yet.
reporting.openAmbiguous: That is either a meeting happening at this moment or a session that never closed, and this figure cannot tell the two apart — a session open for days is the second. Neither its length nor its speech is counted anywhere else on this page.
reporting.absentAverageDuration: No meeting in this server has finished, so there is no length to average.
reporting.absentLongestDuration: No meeting in this server has finished, so there is no length to compare.
reporting.absentAverageParticipants: No meeting in this server has finished, so there is no attendance to average.
reporting.absentLargestMeeting: No meeting in this server has finished, so there is no attendance to compare.
reporting.absentNotZero: This is the absence of a figure and not a figure of zero.
reporting.averageDurationNote: The mean length of the meetings that have ended here.
reporting.longestDurationNote: The longest single meeting this server has recorded from start to finish.
reporting.averageParticipantsNote: The mean number of people recorded in a meeting that has ended here.
reporting.largestMeetingNote: The most people recorded in any one meeting in this server.
reporting.participantsNote: How many different people this server has recorded at all. A count and nothing else — Sturnus does not send this page their names, and this page does not ask.
reporting.speechNoTracks: No audio has been recorded in this server, so there is nothing to have measured. The speaking time above is missing rather than zero.
reporting.speechAllMeasured: The one recorded track in this server carries a measured speaking time, so the figure above covers all of what was recorded. | Every one of the {count} recorded tracks in this server carries a measured speaking time, so the figure above covers all of what was recorded.
reporting.speechNoneMeasured: The one recorded track in this server was never measured for speaking time — it predates the columns that hold it — so there is no speaking time here to report. Read the figure above as a measurement that was never taken, not as a server that was quiet. | None of the {count} recorded tracks in this server was ever measured for speaking time — they all predate the columns that hold it — so there is no speaking time here to report. Read the figure above as a measurement that was never taken, not as a server that was quiet.
reporting.speechPartlyMeasured: One of the {tracks} recorded tracks in this server was never measured for speaking time — it predates the columns that hold it — and a sum skips it in silence. | {count} of the {tracks} recorded tracks in this server were never measured for speaking time — they predate the columns that hold it — and a sum skips them in silence.
reporting.speechPartlyMeasuredTotal: The speaking time above is therefore the total for the other one track only: it describes part of what was recorded, and the larger this number grows the further short the figure falls. | The speaking time above is therefore the total for the other {count} tracks only: it describes part of what was recorded, and the larger this number grows the further short the figure falls.
reporting.speechNotQuiet: It does not mean this server was quiet.
reporting.timezoneUnknown: Sturnus did not say which calendar the months below were cut in, so do not assume it is yours: a meeting near midnight falls on either side of a month boundary depending on the zone. Every instant on this page is written in UTC, which may not be that calendar either.
reporting.timezoneKnown: The months below are cut in {zone}, this server's own calendar — not in UTC and not in yours. A meeting that begins at 00:30 belongs to the month the people in it think it does, which is why Sturnus does not bucket by UTC. The instants elsewhere on this page are written in UTC all the same, because a page rendered on a server cannot know your zone, so a meeting near a month boundary can carry a UTC date that reads as the neighbouring month.
reporting.spanNothing: No meeting has been recorded in this server yet, so this report covers no time at all.
reporting.spanBetween: Everything recorded in this server between {from} and {to}.
reporting.spanPartial: Everything recorded in this server. Only one end of the span is known: {at}.
reporting.spanUnreadable: Everything recorded in this server. Sturnus dated the span with something this console could not read as a time, so neither end of it can be shown.
reporting.monthsNothing: No month in this server has any recording in it yet.
reporting.monthsTooLong: Only the months in which something was recorded are listed, oldest first. This server's history spans more than {years} years, which is too long to list month by month, so the quiet months between these are not shown as rows — two rows next to each other are not necessarily neighbouring months.
reporting.monthsOldestFirst: Every month from the first recording in this server to the most recent one, oldest first.
reporting.monthsAllBusy: Something was recorded in each of them.
reporting.monthsSomeSilent: The one month in which nothing was recorded is listed with a zero rather than left out, so a quiet stretch reads as a gap instead of closing up. | The {count} months in which nothing was recorded are listed with a zero rather than left out, so a quiet stretch reads as a gap instead of closing up.
reporting.monthSilent: {month}: nothing was recorded in this server.
reporting.monthDetail: {month}: one meeting, {recorded} recorded, {documented} written up. | {month}: {count} meetings, {recorded} recorded, {documented} written up.
reporting.monthDetailUnmeasured: {month}: one meeting, no length recorded, {documented} written up. | {month}: {count} meetings, no length recorded, {documented} written up.
reporting.errorSession: Your session has ended. Sign in again to see this server's figures.
reporting.errorNotAdmin: You do not administer this server. Administrators are the members holding the role named by that guild's `admin_role_id`.
reporting.errorUnknownGuild: Sturnus does not know this server, or you no longer administer it — it answers the same way to both. Reload the page; the list of servers is rebuilt from Discord.
reporting.errorUnreachable: Could not reach the API. Nothing here is out of date on purpose; check the connection and retry.
reporting.errorStatus: Sturnus answered {status} and could not produce this server's figures. Nothing is known about why.
